# Sample Project Notes

> Fictional, public test data for an OpenCode Markdown Source. Names, URLs,
> people and environments below are invented for testing only.

## Overview / 專案概覽

This is a general-purpose Markdown example for exercising imports, previews,
full-text reads, unicode handling, keyboard scrolling and exports.
這份範例文件包含中文、英文、Emoji 📚、表格與多段內容，以測試完整顯示及存取。

## Quick-reference table

| Item | Example | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Project | Cedarfield Atlas | Fictional sample |
| Owner | Example Team | No personal information |
| Status | Testing | All values are fake |

## Example configuration

```json
{ "project": "cedarfield-atlas", "language": ["en", "zh-TW"], "enabled": true }
```

## Long document sections

### Example Section 001 — 中文紀錄 📝

This sample section 001 describes a made-up library catalog, shipping schedule and status dashboard. It contains ordinary Markdown text with enough variation to exercise preview scrolling, navigation and exact bytes on Import/Export.
中文段落 001：這是一段虛構測試資料。使用者可以檢視段落、搜尋文字、核對表格、閱讀多個章節，並確認檔案內容完整保存。請勿將這些範例當作真實產品資料。

- Checkpoint 001: Inventory reviewed; sample item count 7.
- Tag 001: 中文標籤、emoji ✅、Markdown links [Example](https://example.invalid/catalog/001).
